final: WITH matched_records AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.trdref, tr.tradekind FROM transactionrecord t JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), type_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(tradekind, 'No type') as trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT trdref) as count FROM matched_records GROUP BY COALESCE(tradekind, 'No type')), stats AS (SELECT AVG(count) as avg_count, SUM(count) as total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT tc.trader_type, tc.count, CAST(tc.count AS FLOAT) / s.total_count as ratio, tc.count - s.avg_count as diff_from_avg FROM type_counts tc CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE s.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND tc.count > s.avg_count ORDER BY tc.count DESC
